description: Machine-readable index of the ApexLogics decision chain-graph: tool nodes + persona journeys. Each tool emits a typed Policy Mandate artifact with a verifiable execution_hash and chain block; journeys are persona-grouped sequences of tools with verified artifact pass-through. Linked from llms.txt and embedded as JSON-LD on the hub. Primary agent-discovery surface.
suite_claim: Client-side, zero-PII life-decision tools whose exports are typed, chainable, and traceable to a reproducible execution hash — verifiable end-to-end, agent-composable, and hand-off-ready to an LLM or human advisor.
five_tests: Emits a typed Policy Mandate decision artifact (ap2_version 2.1.0, mandate_type, tool_id, execution_hash, chain block, payload, audit_signature)
Exposes an MCP tools/call endpoint with typed inputSchema, deterministic output parseable without vision
Exports a decision, not reference data — an ROI, break-even, eligibility verdict, or determination
Is chainable — its mandate_type is a valid inbound type for >=1 other tool (seed edges from CONTRACT §6.3 handoff map)
Carries a verifiable anchor — execution_hash recomputable client-side via WebCrypto SHA-256 (CONTRACT §4.4 / CG-28)

model.rule: 1 chaingraph = 1 persona. A chaingraph bundles that persona's journeys behind an up-front selector (user picks scenario -> only their journey renders). Personas never mix.
model.conversion: in place — each former workflow keeps its URL; upgraded to verified artifact pass-through.
model.embed: minimal compute per step + shared constants module (apex-constants-2026.js). Do not replicate full tools into chaingraphs.

chain_block_spec.parent_hashes: sha256:<execution_hash> of each upstream artifact consumed this run
chain_block_spec.chain_depth: 0 for root; max(parent depths)+1 for chained artifacts
chain_block_spec.hash: sha256 over sorted-key, whitespace-stripped JSON of {policy_parameters, output_payload} via WebCrypto crypto.subtle.digest — identical canonicalization to AINumbers OpenChainGraph, so hashes are cross-suite verifiable
chain_block_spec.verification: re-run the parent tool with the same inputs, recompute the hash, confirm the cited value

generation_contract.note: nodes[] is GENERATED, not hand-maintained, to preserve single-source-of-truth (manifests are the source). Build script: repo/scripts/build_chaingraph.js (to be written). Runs when node/sandbox is available, same place as check_tools.js.
